beats.say: Artificial intelligence can copy a leader's voice from a short recording. Speeches and interviews are enough.
The name and number on screen can be faked too. A familiar-looking call is not proof.
Agree a check phrase in advance. If the caller does not know it, end the call.
The safest way: hang up and call the person yourself on the number you know.

scenes.title: The deputy's voice
scenes.intro: It is eight in the evening. Your phone rings and the deputy's name is on the screen.

actions.label: Answer
actions.feedback: Answering is not dangerous. What matters is what you do next.

actions.label: Decline
actions.feedback: That works too. If you are worried, call the deputy yourself on the number you know.

steps.say: Hi, it is me, Saadat. I am ill and hoarse. Transfer seventy-five thousand manat to a partner tonight, urgently.
steps.spoken: Hi, it is me, Saadat. <throat-clearing> I am ill and hoarse. Transfer seventy-five thousand manat to a partner, uh, tonight, urgently.

actions.label: Please say our check phrase
actions.feedback: Correct. A phrase you agreed on is a stronger check than a voice.

actions.label: All right, I will transfer now
actions.feedback: A familiar voice is no longer proof. This one was made by artificial intelligence and the money is gone.

actions.label: Hang up, I will call back myself
actions.feedback: Good call. Now ring the deputy on the number you know.

steps.say: What phrase? I have no time, the minister is waiting! I will send the papers tomorrow, transfer it now.
steps.spoken: What phrase? <breath> I have no time, the minister is waiting! I will send the papers tomorrow, transfer it now.

actions.label: Hang up
actions.feedback: Correct. A caller who does not know the phrase and pushes you is fake.

actions.label: All right, I will transfer
actions.feedback: Pressure is a sign of dodging the check. The money may never come back.

actions.label: Send me the account number
actions.feedback: Keeping the talk going gives the attacker more chances. Hang up.

steps.label: The call has ended. What now?

actions.label: Call the deputy's number from the phone book
actions.feedback: Correct. A number you dial yourself exposes the fake call at once.

actions.label: Report to the security team
actions.feedback: Excellent. Your report warns finance and colleagues about the same call.

actions.label: Do nothing
actions.feedback: The attacker may now call another colleague. Check and report.

question.prompt: Which makes a good check phrase?

options.label: A word written nowhere that only we two know
options.feedback: Correct. A word that is not online cannot be copied.

options.label: The deputy's date of birth
options.feedback: A date of birth can be found online.

options.label: The organisation's name and room number
options.feedback: Many people know this, so it is no check.

scenes.explain: Agree the phrase in person and never send it by email or message.

scenes.prompt: Match each fact with what it means.

pairs.right: No proof, it can be copied
The number can be faked too
An attempt to skip the check

scenes.explain: Trust the agreed rule, not the voice or the name on screen.

nodes.text: Send the partner the advance tonight.
nodes.speaker: The minister (video call, the sound breaks up)
nodes.spoken: Send the partner the advance <short pause> tonight.

choices.label: I end the call and ring the assistant on the number I know
choices.feedback: Correct. Video can be faked too, a second channel is still the rule.

choices.label: I can see his face, so it is real
choices.feedback: Artificial intelligence can fake video as well. A picture alone is no proof.

nodes.text: The minister is travelling and called nobody.
nodes.speaker: The minister's assistant
nodes.spoken: The minister is travelling <breath> and called nobody.

choices.label: I report to the security team and note the time and account name
choices.feedback: Excellent. These notes help specialists trace the attack.

choices.label: No money left, so I tell nobody
choices.feedback: The next target may be the deputy or finance. Reporting protects everyone.

points: A familiar voice, face or name is no proof.
Ask for the check phrase, hang up and call back yourself.
Report a fake call to the security team at once.
